title: Deity of the Holy Spirit
definition: The Deity of the Holy Spirit means the Holy Spirit is fully God, sharing the divine nature with the Father and the Son.
summary: The Deity of the Holy Spirit means the Holy Spirit is fully God, sharing the divine nature with the Father and the Son.
christFocus: Jesus sends the Spirit as the divine Helper, and the Spirit does what only God can do: give life, dwell in believers, sanctify, reveal truth, and glorify Christ.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit is not less than God. Scripture identifies Him with God's presence, power, truth, holiness, and life. To lie to the Spirit is to lie to God, and to be indwelt by the Spirit is to be indwelt by God.

His deity matters because believers need more than human encouragement. They need divine power for new birth, holiness, comfort, assurance, and mission. The Spirit is able because He is God.

The Spirit works in perfect unity with the Father and the Son. He glorifies Christ, applies salvation, and brings God's presence to His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
If the Spirit is treated as less than God, believers will either ignore Him or try to use Him. Scripture calls them instead to worship, trust, and depend on Him as Lord and giver of life.

This doctrine gives hope to weak believers. The power at work in them is not merely their own resolve but the presence of God the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Honor the Holy Spirit as God. Depend on Him for understanding, holiness, prayer, endurance, and witness, and do not try to live the Christian life in your own strength.
